name: rekordbox-mcp
description: Give Claude direct access to your rekordbox library — search, playlists, cues, tags, ratings, history, and imports.
long_description: Connects Claude to your local rekordbox 6/7 database (read + write) via pyrekordbox. Search and analyze your collection, build and edit playlists, place hot cues with beat-grid snapping, edit ratings/colors/comments/MyTags, import tracks, and mine your DJ history. Writes automatically back up the database first and require rekordbox to be closed (pyrekordbox blocks commits while it runs). Built on the rekordbox-mcp server originally created by Dave Henke; this build adds cue-point, metadata-editing, and import tooling. Requires `uv` (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on your PATH — the extension launches the Python server through it, which resolves the correct native dependencies on first run.
